topic: agentic-corpus impl: deferred items across all phases
notes:
Tracks all deferred items accumulated across 30 leapfrog cycles implementing `design/agentic-corpus.md` on branch `agentic-corpus-impl`. Each item is from a per-phase review filed under `feedback/*-review.md` — those files have the full context. Items grouped by domain.

## Engine-level follow-ups (require workflow engine changes)

- **Workflow `foreach`/matrix primitive** — tracked in sibling thread `thread-cba8bfa1`. Eval harness, multi-partition compaction, multi-candidate auto-edge all need this. Today: shell-out wrapper or one-iteration-per-tick.
- **`op: shell` stdout capture for gate consumption** — H3's nightly-eval-arc and several others ship as observable skeletons because gate predicates can only see workflow vars + node prompt output, not subprocess stdout. When this lands, gate routing on actual results becomes possible.
- **Per-turn MCP tool-call budget for agentic actor** — `policy_packet` watches workflow steps, not LLM-internal tool calls. Soft prompt budget is the v1 workaround. Codex round-5 of design deliberation flagged this; defer until eval shows runaway loops.
- **`bro_exec` `task-completed` signal emission** — auto-digest-arc's routing trigger. Today the routing packet exists but never fires because `bro_exec` doesn't emit the signal. Operator triggers manually via `bbox_orchestrate_run`.
- **`bbox_project_register` auto-trigger of bootstrap-arc** — registration just adds to project list; bootstrap arc must be invoked separately. Same shape as task-completed gap.
- **Engine-driven whiteboard auto-post** — specialists are prompt-instructed to call `whiteboard_post`; silent failure if forgotten. Either completion-gate per node OR engine-driven auto-post from strict JSON output.

## Provenance gaps (P1, P2, G2)

- **Backfill tool-call edges for newly-registered projects** (P1 review #3) — only future tool calls produce edges; reindex-time backfill against historical transcripts is the gap.
- **`bbox_blame` doesn't share `provenance_for(entity_ref)` helper with `bbox_inspect_entity`** (P2 review #6) — both surface entity provenance via similar walks.
- **`ARC_PRODUCED_COMMIT` edge wiring** (G2) — design called for arcs to record their producing commit SHA in `on_arc_exit`; not yet wired. M2-M5 arcs could populate.
- **Bidirectional git-notes sync hooks** (G2 review #6) — push-notes-on-commit + pull-notes-on-fetch automation. Today: operator runs `bbox_provenance_export` / `bbox_provenance_import` manually + `git push refs/notes/bbox/*`.

## Storage / scaling cliffs

- **EdgeIndex `HashSet<Edge>` dedup memory at >5M edges** (S4 review #3) — full Edge struct as HashSet key; clones on every insert. Switch to hash-keyed dedup before crossing.
- **`edge_projection_docs` AllQuery + TopDocs::with_limit at >100k docs** (S4 review #2) — codex added `tracing::warn!` at 100k; refactor to streaming/segment iteration before that fires in production.
- **`HnswMetrics` health metrics** (E3 review #6) — neighbor-degree distribution, layer-occupancy stats. Useful for diagnosing search quality regressions.
- **`VectorStore` singleton refactor** (E3 review #5) — `OnceLock<Arc<VectorStore>>` for module-level free functions; testing harder. Pass &VectorStore explicitly.
- **`matching_anchors` / `prior_read_edges` indexed by anchor** (P2 review #1, #2) — codex's P2 fixes added per-commit and per-session indices, but they only cover the specific anchor lookups in `bbox_blame`. Future provenance walks might need similar.

## Producer machinery / arcs

- **Auto-edge processes ONE candidate per invocation** (M5 review #1) — `extract_candidate_pairs` returns up to 50 but workflow operates on `vars.candidate` (singular). Needs `foreach` engine primitive OR cron-fans-out N times.
- **Auto-edge ensemble vote parsing** (M5 review #2) — 3 ensemble outputs concatenate; `parse_json` on concatenation either needs ensemble-aware parser OR per-member output API.
- **Team install paths** (M4 review #1, M5 issue #3) — `contradiction-specialists` and `auto-edge-classifiers` teams referenced by ensemble actors but no automated install. Either F4 catalog grows team artifact kind OR install-teams.sh script.
- **Multi-partition compaction per arc tick** (M2 review #3) — picks worst partition only; others wait for next cron.
- **Auto-digest's `source_query` field absent from trigger payload** (M3 review #2) — codex's M3 fix relaxed the rule (reject only when ALL three sources absent), but the trigger plumbing for `source_query` is still missing. When task-completed signal lands, populate it.

## Ranking / search

- **Combined rerank multiplier tuning** (H1 review #3) — capped at 1.5× via H1 fix; empirical tuning against eval suite still open.
- **Embed-on-search latency** (H1 review #4) — 100-500ms per interactive query. Cache query embeddings or async-fill BM25-first.
- **`include_vectors=false` response field semantics** (H1 review #5) — should omit vector_status fields rather than report empty queues.
- **Per-class checker logic refinement beyond Any/All/First** (F2b review #1) — pass_strictness covers v1 but per-query-class richness (e.g. "≥2 of expected", "must include path validation") is open.

## Eval / observability

- **`expected_entity_refs` snapshot drift script** (F2b review #3) — corpus content changes; `eval/scripts/refresh_expected_refs.sh` to detect + propose updates.
- **Eval workflow gate doesn't consume scoreboard** (H3 review #1) — same shape as the `op: shell` engine gap above. nightly-eval-arc records that the harness ran; can't route on actual drift.
- **Audit example sets shipped per packet, but CI integration missing** (H5) — `eval/audit/<domain>/*.json` exist; need `cargo test` task or CI step that runs `bbox_audit` on each as a regression gate.

## Schema / chunking

- **Markdown `LINKS_TO_FILE` / `LINKS_TO_SECTION` target resolution** (S2 review #1) — codex stopped emitting these self-loop edges; resolution needs EdgeIndex chunk-by-(file, hash) lookup. Defer to post-S4 EdgeIndex enhancement.
- **`chunk_kind` expansion for IMG/AV** — markers; chunk_kind enum already designed to accept these.
- **Tier B AST per-language extension** — Y-* markers (7 languages); naive symbol-table CALLS resolution today. Rust-analyzer integration most useful for this repo.

## Live-daemon caveats (not architectural; just unblocks observation)

- **`blackboxd-dev` on :7265 is older binary** — F4 artifact endpoints + new MCP tools unavailable until restart. Reinstall + restart to exercise the new surface.
- **Live agent-edited-line chain unverified for `bbox_blame`** (P2 done note) — daemon corpus lacks P1 anchors until new binary runs. Restart + edit + commit cycle would verify.

## How to use this thread

When picking the next leapfrog cycle (or shipping v1), pull from this list. Each section is roughly priority-ordered within. The full per-item context is in `feedback/<phase>-review.md` files committed on the branch.

## Update — 2026-05-06 quality-arc closeout

This session added significant fixes that closed several deferred items from the original list. Below is a status update + new deferred items uncovered.

### Closed in this session

- **`bbox_project_register` auto-trigger of bootstrap-arc** (Engine §5) — `bbox_project_register` now calls `rebuild_edge_index_from_stores` AFTER reindex (commit 19d3760), so freshly-derived edges from the new project's chunks land in EdgeIndex. The auto-reindex thread also has a watcher (`spawn_edge_index_rebuild_watcher`) that polls TranscriptIndex::num_docs() every 60s and triggers rebuild when corpus grows.
- **EdgeIndex projection from KnowledgeEntry / Commit / project_file edges** (S4, P1, P2 review #6) — All three families now project correctly. Commits show COMMIT_PARENT + COMMIT_TOUCHED_FILE; project_files show IN_FILE + CONTAINS_SYMBOL + READ_FILE / EDITED_BY_SESSION; knowledge entries show KNOWLEDGE_FROM_SESSION when source_session is set.
- **EdgeIndex `HashSet<Edge>` dedup memory + duplicate edges** (S4 #3) — `EdgeIndex::insert` now keys dedup on (source, kind, target, provenance, confidence) with metadata stripped. Cut 21k duplicate edges from a 1.17M corpus (commit f170080).
- **`include_vectors=false` semantics** — verified working as intended (vector path skipped when false; the field is informational, not an "omit from response" flag).
- **Cross-project keyword pollution** — fixed by `project=` filter on hybrid_search/discover_seed (commit 10a3e1a).
- **STATUS.md / high-mention-but-spread underranked** — fixed by per-file BM25 aggregation as a 3rd RRF signal weighted by sum*sqrt(count) (commit 377a23f).
- **Single-token symbol queries underrank defining file** — fixed by elixir AST symbol extraction + tokenized symbol field + symbol_exact 6× boost for single-token queries (commit f410f11).
- **bundle_evidence intra_bundle_edges always empty** — kept the 1-hop check; added `intra_bundle_convergences` 2-hop pass that surfaces shared session/commit links between bundled entities (commit aba4089).
- **bbox_blame git -C bug** — fixed (was passing file path to `git -C` which requires a directory), commit b458289.
- **Voyage error wrapper swallows body / queue drains everything in single batch** — both fixed in commit b458289. Cap at 64 docs / 80 KB per batch.
- **`include_vectors=false` should suppress vector_status block** — confirmed bug in feedback/search-quality-walk.md gap #1; intentional that vector_status reports queue state always; not a blocker. CLOSED as informational.
- **`hot_summary` truncation** — fixed (12 -> 240 bytes word-aware), commit 386271a.

### NEW deferred items surfaced this session

- **bbox_blame anchor-metadata file_path mismatch** — when multiple Edit tool calls share a commit_sha, the matched anchor returns the FIRST anchor's metadata.file_path, not the file actually being blamed. Causes confusing surprise notes from agents (codex caught this on Q1 of probe-team validation). Fix: filter anchors by file_path match too, not just commit_sha. See feedback/probe-team-q1.md.
- **Opencode bros (glm, deepseek) don't load BLACKBOX.md @-imports** — they have access to bbox MCP tools per `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` but their behavioral default is `grep`/`read`. The rendered guidance in `~/.claude-shared/BLACKBOX.md` reaches them only if opencode honors AGENTS.md @-imports. Investigation needed: does opencode chase `@/path/...` paths? If not, render to opencode's expected location too. Tracked separately from the scout-subagent thread (thread-f4e4624f).
- **Opencode SQLite session-DB lock** under parallel runs — two opencode bros running concurrently get "database is locked" errors. Stagger or per-bro DB needed.
- **Codex over-explores on conceptual queries** — quality high but 2× claude latency on the WHERE probe. Consider tightening codex-gpt55 brofile lens with explicit "stop when answered."
- **file: virtual entity for IN_FILE schema cleanup** — currently chunk[0] proxies as the file. Cleaner schema would be `file:<project_id>:<rel_path_hash>` virtual entity. Schema bump required. Listed in feedback/search-quality-walk.md gap #2.
- **Per-turn LLM scoring for ranker** — H1 #3 multiplier tuning could move to learned weights eventually.
- **Probe-team Q2-Q8 (WHO/WHEN, WHY, HOW, REPLACEMENT, HISTORICAL, IMPACT, WHAT)** — only Q1 dispatched this session. Each question has a designed checklist for evaluating cold-start grounding behavior.

Multimodal leftovers now have a focused follow-up design doc: `design/multimodal-embedding-routing.md`, committed on `main` as `8cade63 Add multimodal embedding routing design`. The doc supersedes the embedding-model selection and multimodal-routing portions of the original agentic-corpus design. It records the Voyage 4 / voyage-multimodal-3.5 update, requires query/document `input_type` correction, splits text/code/visual route families, derives compatibility families in code, and adds a partition lifecycle phase for route/model churn.
